title: Cascade Vision Fitting Allowance Tied to the Contact Lenses the Fitting Serves
content:
On a Vision Plans contact-lens order, the fitting allowance follows the contact lenses the fitting serves.

**Which contact lenses the fitting serves**

(a) **The order's own contact-lens line**, when this same decision settles it under the contacts benefit. That is the case when all three hold:
- the plan has a contact-lens benefit and covers medically necessary contacts in network;
- the contact-lens benefit is available again under the plan's contact-lens frequency, counted from the latest paid or reimbursed contact-lens service of the enrollment (a lone reversed service on that date counting as none); and
- no spectacle-lens or frame service of the same person counts in the order's benefit period, and the order's own claim carries no spectacle-lens or frame line that has no remark yet or stands denied as not eligible.

A spectacle-lens or frame service counts in the period when it is the latest paid or reimbursed service of its kind and is dated in the same benefit period as the order, whatever its order. The benefit period starts each year on the enrollment's benefit-period reset day.

(b) **Otherwise, the latest contact-lens service of the enrollment** whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, when it is dated no more than 60 calendar days before or after the fitting. When that latest one is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none and no earlier one is looked at; of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing.

**The allowance**

| Contact lenses the fitting serves | Fitting allowance |
|---|---|
| Certified by the provider as medically necessary | 120.00 |
| Elective | The plan's specialty fitting allowance |
| No such contact lenses on record | None (0.00) |

**Window boundary (hypothetical dates).** The order's own lenses are not settled under the benefit, and the latest paid contact lenses are dated 60 days before the fitting: they are within the window. At 61 days they are not, and the fitting has no allowance from this rule.
